title: Doozy Vape Co Golden Elixer E-Liquid 10ml
description: Golden Elixir is a beguiling blend of rich, earthy tobacco softened beautifully with layers of smooth caramel and butterscotch. Delicately balanced and effortlessly moreish, this juice is ideal for tobacco lovers with a sweet tooth. The 70% Vegetable Glycerine, 30% Propylene Glycol formula makes this eliquid ideal for sub-ohm vaping, producing mighty clouds on top of fantastic flavour and a smooth, comfortable, throat hit. Sub-ohm vaping generally requires the use of high-powered vape kits, including pod vape kits and pod mods with higher power outputs, some pen vape kits and advanced kits .
